_comment: The candidate model that posting compatibility is scored against.
`skills` and `strongSkills` must be keys of SKILL_LEXICON in src/config.js;
anything else is dropped and reported as a config warning on the next run.
`strongSkills` are the ones you'd be interviewed on — they earn a bonus when
a posting asks for them. `preferredFamilies` is ordered: first is best fit.
_workAuthorizationComment: Answers to the work-authorization questions nearly every form asks. These are
typed verbatim into real employment applications, so they must be true.
A Canadian citizen holding no US visa is not authorized to work in the US and
does require sponsorship — being able or willing to relocate is not authorization.
A country absent from this map means 'we don't know', and the applier will abort
rather than answer. Never add a country you cannot answer honestly for.
